translations.web: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.
translations.bsb: Your life will be brighter than noonday; its darkness will be like the morning.
translations.kjv: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday; thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.
translations.asv: And thy life shall be clearer than the noonday; Though there be darkness, it shall be as the morning.
